name: FM planning
notes: Planning lane: the first mate, secondmates and judgment work (architecture, ambiguous debugging, design, final review). Plan-only scouts, never a ship.

name: FM contributor
notes: Contributor lane (default): most scouts, well-specified ships, fan-out, scraping, bulk edits. To switch it back to the cheap OpenCode model, set provider opencode, model opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor, modeId build, featureValues {auto_accept: true} (OpenCode has no bypassPermissions; needs OpenCode >= 2.0.10), remove thinkingOptionId, then apply and check.

name: FM fallback
notes: Fallback for the contributor lane when fm-contributor cannot start. Known-good Sonnet 5.5 at medium thinking; equal to fm-contributor while that is on Sonnet.
